facts.text: Dripping Springs got its name from the dripping springs at the Milk House Branch of the Edwards Aquifer, a gathering place for the Tonkawa Indians.
In 2014, Dripping Springs became Texas’s first Dark Sky Community, drawing stargazers to its exceptionally clear night skies.
The Grammy‑nominated country band Midland was formed right here in 2014, with members still living on local ranches that double as songwriting hubs.
Three families from Mississippi left their wagons in the late fall of 1853, marking the first organized move that would become Dripping Springs.
Born in Dripping Springs in 1868, newspaper publisher Leonidas Johnson Rountree later became a noted author and subject of the documentary Last Man Standing.
